name: CTC-5
description: The Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority operates a fleet of approximately 300 bilevel railcars on its Commuter Rail system. The cars are manufactured to the MBTA's specification by Kawasaki Railcar Manufacturing and Hyundai Rotem, in 7 variants that include standard coaches and cab cars. The first cars entered service in 1990, and new cars are planned to be built until the late 2020s.
